Hi, I’m Jonas Richter (German passport holder), born 18 April 1990 in Leipzig and currently living in Berlin. I’m planning a tourism trip to Australia from **05 Oct 2026 to 27 Oct 2026**, mainly around Sydney, including about **7 nights staying with my friend Mia Schneider in Redfern (NSW)** and the rest in hotels. I’m employed full-time as a **Marketing Specialist at NordKonsum GmbH** and I’ll be **self-funding** the trip (estimated **AUD 5,500**), with a **single entry** planned and a return flight booked to Germany.

Please help me fill out the **Australia Visitor visa – Tourist stream (Form 1419)**.
